status: written before any Step 6 v2 SHAP evaluation (Nov 17, 2026); protocol step6-v2 itself is unchanged
role_note: 10 Step 6 v2 flows and the current pinned RF/XGBoost models; not the final experimental design; never pooled with final results
candidates_note: the same enumeration, deduplication and candidate ids as experiments/unsw_step6_exhaustive.py (1,108 unique physical_v1 candidates for the 10 flows)

explainer.random_forest: shap.TreeExplainer(model, data=background); probability scale of the attack class
explainer.grouping: one-hot columns summed back to the 42 original features

measures: sign agreement in the shared top-10
success_criterion_d11: decision D11 (docs/step6_v2_decisions.md), unchanged: still attack AND passes the enforced policy (valid physical_v1 candidate) AND physical status consistent_with_checked_rules AND J(x,x') <= J_ref AND rho(x,x') <= rho_ref, with J = top-10 Jaccard and rho = tie-aware Spearman on |SHAP| over the 42 features; J_ref and rho_ref = mean over held-out LIME seeds 22/33/44/55 of the same measures between SHAP(x) and LIME_s(x) on the original flow
reported_not_criteria: comparison with the LIME pilot on the same candidates
checks: candidate set and P(attack) equal the LIME pilot
pinned model hashes before and after the run
